main.description: A verified or self-asserted link between the authenticated atproto identity and an external code-forge account (e.g. GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo).

username.description: Account username or handle on the forge.

host.description: Host for self-hosted instances (e.g. 'codeberg.org'). Omit for the provider's canonical host.

displayName.description: Human-friendly display name on the forge.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the account avatar image.

profileUrl.description: URL of the account's public profile page.

verified.description: Self-asserted ownership flag. NOT a trust signal on its own: the record owner can freely set it. Only treat the link as verified when a valid 'attestation' is present and checks out.

attestation.description: Compact JWS (ES256) issued by the maintainers.space server binding this account to the record owner's DID. Its payload asserts { sub: <owner did>, provider, username }. Because it is signed with the server's private key, the record owner cannot forge or tamper with it. Verified against the issuer's JWKS.

attestedBy.description: Origin of the maintainers.space server that issued 'attestation'. Its public keys are published at '<attestedBy>/.well-known/jwks.json'. Verifiers must pin this to a trusted issuer.
